inputs.text:
It is deeply concerning to see how local leadership in Phoenix is bowing to lawless agendas and undermining fundamental security. On Wednesday night, city officials caved to progressive pressure by approving a plan that places new restrictions on ICE and other law enforcement agencies using city property, as reported by FOX 10's Danielle Miller. 

Instead of backing the rule of law and supporting those who keep our streets safe, these municipal leaders are tying the hands of federal authorities. This move toward sanctuary policies completely ignores personal responsibility and national sovereignty, sending a dangerous signal that local resources can be weaponized against the very framework of law and order that holds our communities together. Traditional civic duty is being cast aside to appease agitators who demand open borders at the expense of public safety and social order.
